Contributor Code of Conduct

Source: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

This project follows the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1.

In short, everyone taking part in this project, as a maintainer, contributor or user, is expected to be respectful and constructive, to welcome people of every background and level of experience, and to accept feedback gracefully. Harassment, insults and personal attacks are not tolerated.

Problems can be reported to the maintainer at nhanhocumc@gmail.com. All reports will be reviewed promptly and handled in confidence, and the maintainer may remove comments or contributions, or exclude people from the project, in line with the full text of the Covenant.

Developed by Nhan Thi Ho.
